trigger_reasons: acceptance criteria mention user-visible error text
summary: Login form returns null while submitting and never surfaces network failures.

findings.trigger: Submit valid credentials on a slow network.
findings.expected: Show a loading state and keep the form structure; announce progress to assistive tech.
findings.actual: Component unmounts to null; user sees a blank region with no status.
findings.impact: Users cannot tell whether login is in progress; screen reader users lose context.
findings.fix: Keep the form mounted; set aria-busy; disable the submit button; show inline progress text.
findings.evidence_detail: Conditional return null removes all DOM for the form during submit.

non_findings: Submit button has a visible text label in the idle state.
